title: A Genotype-Phenotype Analysis of Four Chinese Children Carrying Distinct Pathogenic Variants in the CTCF Gene.
authors: Du, Juan; Li, Muhan; Liang, Aimin; Hei, Mingyan; Ren, Xiaotun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CTCF基因变异导致的智力障碍，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
abstract: Objective: The objective of this study was to analyze the clinical phenotypes and genetic variant characteristics of four unrelated Chinese children carrying pathogenic variants in the CTCF gene and to explore the genotype-phenotype heterogeneity of autosomal dominant intellectual disability type 21 (MRD21, OMIM 615,502). Methods: Four pediatric patients admitted to Beijing Children's Hospital, Capital Medical University, from 2020 to 2024 were enrolled in this retrospective study. All patients underwent medical history collection, physical examination, laboratory tests and high-throughput sequencing. Identified variants were verified in the probands and parents via Sanger sequencing or CNV-seq. Results: Four distinct heterozygous CTCF variants were identified: a missense variant c.1117C>T (p.His373Tyr); an 8.92 Mb microdeletion at 16q21-q22.1 (arr[GRCh37] 16q21q22.1(58,986,875-67,907,636)x1), encompassing the entire CTCF gene; a frameshift deletion c.615_618delGAAA (p.Lys206Profs*15); and an intragenic deletion of exons 8-10. Parental testing confirmed that all identified variants were of de novo origin. The missense variant and the frameshift deletion have been reported previously in ClinVar (VCV000521287.19 and VCV001308122.2), but the two deletions were not found in public databases. Three patients presented with global developmental delay consistent with MRD21, with variable additional features including autistic-like behavior and facial dysmorphism. Notably, two of these patients showed somatic overgrowth with height and weight above the 97th percentile, contrasting with the short stature classically emphasized in MRD21. The fourth patient was a preterm infant with neonatal chylothorax, cardiopulmonary failure, and multiple congenital cardiovascular malformations; developmental assessment at a corrected age of 11 months showed only mild lags. Conclusions: This study expands the spectrum of pathogenic CTCF variants in the Chinese population and underscores the marked phenotypic heterogeneity of CTCF-related disorders, ranging from benign developmental outcomes with complete catch-up to severe neonatal multisystem involvement. In neonates presenting with unexplained chylothorax and multisystem abnormalities, especially when accompanied by features suggestive of a neurodevelopmental syndrome, CTCF should be considered in the differential diagnosis. Given this heterogeneity, a broad genomic approach rather than targeted CTCF screening is recommended in patients with complex presentations.
abstract_zh: 目的：分析4例携带CTCF基因致病性变异的不相关中国患儿的临床表型及遗传变异特征，并探讨常染色体显性智力障碍21型（MRD21, OMIM 615,502）的基因型-表型异质性。方法：纳入2020年至2024年首都医科大学附属北京儿童医院收治的4例儿科患者进行回顾性研究。所有患者均接受病史采集、体格检查、实验室检查及高通量测序。通过Sanger测序或CNV-seq在先证者及其父母中验证所鉴定的变异。结果：共鉴定出4种不同的杂合CTCF变异：一个错义变异c.1117C>T（p.His373Tyr）；一个16q21-q22.1的8.92 Mb微缺失（arr[GRCh37] 16q21q22.1(58,986,875-67,907,636)x1），涵盖整个CTCF基因；一个移码缺失c.615_618delGAAA（p.Lys206Profs*15）；以及一个外显子8-10的基因内缺失。父母检测证实所有鉴定变异均为新生起源。错义变异和移码缺失此前已在ClinVar中报道（VCV000521287.19和VCV001308122.2），但两个缺失未在公共数据库中发现。3例患者表现为与MRD21一致的全面发育迟缓，并伴有可变的其他特征，包括自闭症样行为和面部畸形。值得注意的是，其中2例患者表现出躯体过度生长，身高和体重超过第97百分位，与MRD21中经典强调的矮小身材形成对比。第4例患者为早产儿，伴有新生儿乳糜胸、心肺衰竭及多种先天性心血管畸形；在校正年龄11个月时的发育评估仅显示轻度落后。结论：本研究扩展了中国人群中CTCF致病性变异的谱系，并强调了CTCF相关疾病显著的表型异质性，范围从完全追赶的良性发育结局到严重的新生儿多系统受累。在表现为不明原因乳糜胸及多系统异常的新生儿中，尤其是伴有提示神经发育综合征特征时，应考虑将CTCF纳入鉴别诊断。鉴于这种异质性，在复杂表现的患者中建议采用广泛的基因组方法而非靶向CTCF筛查。
